subject: Proactive reassignment and backfill request — Senior SWE (Platform)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proactive reassignment and backfill request — Senior SWE (Platform)

Hi team,

Quick update and ask following the end-of-cycle 1:1s. Maya Desai (Senior SWE, Platform) has accepted an external offer and will be leaving the company on 2026-12-10 after a two-week notice. Maya is the primary owner for the runtime tracing work and the prefix-caching improvements that land in Q1.

Options I’m proposing and the recommendation:
- Option A (recommended): Post a replacement Senior SWE and engage a contractor for 6–8 weeks to cover immediate operational risk.
- Option B: Reassign two ICs from infra and tools for a 10-week rotation (will move roadmap items).
- Option C: Defer the tracing scope and prioritize KV-cache perf; postpone hire until mid-Q2 (saves ~1 headcount this FY).

Attached: org-chart_Q4_v2.pdf, JD_Senior_SW_Platform.md, performance-summary_maya_desai.pdf (summary for context).

Ask: I need a freeze-exception decision by EOD Monday 2026-11-30 so recruiting can start if we choose Option A. If we go with internal reassignments, I’ll circulate a mitigation plan and impact matrix.

Impact notes:
- SLA/customer-impact risk if tracing improvements are delayed: increased tail latency for high-concurrency customers; estimated additional infra cost $15–30k/month if not addressed.
- Budget: I can cover a contractor from the platform discretionary buffer for up to 8 weeks; a full headcount hire would require approval against the FY26 reserve.

Thanks — details below and happy to sync 15m if helpful.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

----

- org-chart_Q4_v2.pdf (1.2MB)
- JD_Senior_SW_Platform.md (1.1KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proactive reassignment and backfill request — Senior SWE (Platform)

Thanks for the heads-up, Priyom. A few quick clarifying questions so we can decide Monday: 

1) Net-new headcount delta: if we approve Option A now, are you requesting an additional 1 FTE beyond current commitments, or will this be a swap from the HC reserve? Please call out the funding line.
2) Contractor plan: if we engage a contractor, estimated weekly cost and expected ramp timeline?
3) Roadmap tradeoffs: for Option B what are the exact features that would be delayed, and who owns upstream dependencies?

Can you drop the performance summary for Maya into the thread (I can’t open PDFs from my phone). Also paste a 1-paragraph customer-SLA risk summary for the execs.

If the risk is high and the contractor + hire is the safer route, flag that explicitly — we’ll escalate to Rishi for approval.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proactive reassignment and backfill request — Senior SWE (Platform)

Priyom —
I lean toward Option A (hire + short contractor) to avoid roadmap drift. A few data points:
- If tracing work slips by one-quarter we estimate ~0.6% ARR drag for two mid-market customers due to increased p99 timeouts (conservative).
- Budget: we have an open deferred req in Infra (HEADCOUNT-453) that could be reallocated if leadership signs off; otherwise the FY26 reserve needs to be used.

If Laura prefers not to pull reserve HC yet, I’d propose a compromise: approve a 12-week contractor now (funded from Platform discretionary) and start a parallel external hire. Contractor cost estimate: $7.5k–$10k/week depending on seniority. Ramp to full productivity in ~3 weeks.

I’ll attach a short risk matrix to this thread later today.

—Karthik
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
From: Kelly Turner <kelly@vendorstaff.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proactive reassignment and backfill request — Senior SWE (Platform)

Hi Priyom / Karthik,
Thanks for reaching out. We have a shortlist of three contractors with direct experience in LLM serving runtimes and low-latency tracing. Typical availability: 2 weeks to start; expected weekly rate $7k–9k. Candidate-pack.pdf attached (profiles, availability, references).

Notes on contractor-to-hire conversions: if you convert a contractor into a Redwoods headcount within 12 weeks, standard conversion fee is 15% of first-year comp. We can provide a refundable hold for a 7-day exclusive window for any candidate we present.

I can do a quick screen + submit profiles tomorrow if you want us to start.

—Kelly Turner
Vendor Partnerships Lead
VendorStaff Inc.

Attachment stub:
- candidate-pack.pdf (420KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proactive reassignment and backfill request — Senior SWE (Platform)

Team — thanks for the clear summary and options. I approve a freeze-exception for one Senior SWE hire (Option A) and immediate engagement with VendorStaff for a contractor up to 12 weeks. Conditions: 

• Funding: Hire will be charged to FY26 reserve and reconciled in the next budget review. Contractor spend can come from Platform discretionary for up to 12 weeks.
• Timeline: Post req by EOD Tuesday (11/30); contractor start window no later than 2 weeks after vendor receives LOI.
• Reporting: Weekly standup updates to Laura and me covering ramp, blockers, and customer-impact metrics.
• Re-evaluation: We’ll re-evaluate headcount posture at the end of the 12-week window and decide whether to convert contractor or close the req.

Priyom — please proceed with posting the JD, loop TalentOps for req creation, and engage Kelly to present candidates. Laura, Karthik — please keep me in the loop on the risk metrics.

Approved — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
